name: Goal-relevant admission at a precision floor with nothing out of scope
purpose: Measures whether the items admitted to the working stream are the ones the request's goal needs. Read in this direction: maximise needed items admitted at or above a precision floor; admit no out-of-scope item; minimise model calls per step.
record: Per implementation on the same labelled steps: recall of needed items at the precision floor, near misses admitted, out-of-scope items admitted, and model calls per step; one row per run pinned to the commit and the cases hash.
disadvantages: Not built: no case set, arm or command exists yet. The labels of needed and near miss are the case author's judgment; items are judged one step at a time, so it cannot see whether the final answer improved.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the recency_window offline arm of admit_to_the_mind runs the whole case set with no model call]

name: Justified share of model spend
purpose: share of AVERAGE model spend on prompts that are registered, whose owner metric has a current row on production-shaped cases, and whose call beats its ablation on average while its MAXIMUM cost, tokens and latency stay within that prompt's own budget (bar 0.8). Kept per prompt: fire rate per turn, tokens in and out, dollars per call, latency and whether it is on the critical path, each as average and maximum; budgets set per prompt from the value its owner metric shows. Stats come from the per-call usage records tagged with the spec id and from production-shaped eval cases; until production data exists rows come from eval traces and are labelled so.
record: Per prompt and in total, with the commit and the cases hash; one row per run. NOT BUILT: unmeasured until its arm exists.
disadvantages: Not built: no ablation arm, command or row exists, and spend-weighted value is not computed. Rows from eval traces are not production data and are labelled so; a budget set from a weak owner metric inherits its weakness.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the spec_registry_ablation offline arm of justified_model_spend runs the whole case set with no model call]

name: Justified model spend
purpose: share of average model spend that is justified: registered, measured by its owner metric, better than its ablation and inside its own budget
record: share of average model spend that is justified: registered, measured by its owner metric, better than its ablation and inside its own budget. Read from metric-justified-model-spend; NOT BUILT, so it keeps its weight unmeasured.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the spec_registry_ablation offline arm of justified_model_spend runs the whole case set with no model call]

name: Model tier selection and limit-recognition correctness
purpose: offline cases: deep starting rung per difficulty and ladder (synonyms, unknown rating, off-ladder start, operator mapping), family resolution to the newest live id, tier resolution with and without live models and pins, lower-tier fallback, vision capability, outage wording, usage-limit detection and reset parsing; zero model calls Read in this direction: maximise the share of work started on the cheapest adequate rung; maximise correct resolution of names to live models with operator pins always winning; maximise correct recognition of outages and allowance limits and of their reset time. Measures that the right model is chosen, not that it was the cheapest one that still succeeded, which needs live runs.
record: The pass rate, passed cases out of cases run, of the live implementation on the rule's cases, recorded as a row of the results file pinned to the commit and the cases hash; a rule holds or does not, so the implementations are never ranked and a deliberately broken baseline must fail the same cases.
cascading_conditionals: offline [sample=full | real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the qar_selection offline arm of choose_a_model_tier runs the whole case set with no model call]
